caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a lidded pewter or metal pitcher, rendered in shades of gray and black, giving it a metallic appearance. The pitcher has a curved spout on the left, a sturdy handle on the right, and a domed hinged lid with a decorative finial at the top. The surface of the pitcher features engraved writing, which reads: "To Warrie, from his Gran, Dec. 25, 1859." The pitcher sits on a surface and is centered inside a double-lined rectangular border. The background of the image is plain and off-white, with some brownish stains and spotting near the lower left and bottom border areas. The overall composition is focused solely on the pitcher, with no other objects or elements present.
title: Silver Tankard
